summary: ArcBot's Skills menu now lists skills the team keeps on the server, starting with DFM Diagnostics for the open DFM.
details: DFM Diagnostics opens the diagnostic triangle, flags unusual early values, suggests ratio selections, and reviews last quarter's excluded ratios.
A skill only advises: it never changes a method, and it needs the matching window open.
Show Diagnostic Triangle now finds a DFM's triangle in the skill's JSON mapping instead of the old workbook.
Claude models can use project reads and macros while a skill runs.
